exposure: years of experience as an OBGYN
outcome: preferred mode of delivery for self or partner
willingness to perform cesarean delivery on maternal request
cohort: 370 Thai obstetricians and gynecologists who responded to a mailed survey (18.9% response rate).
finding: While the majority of Thai OBGYNs in this study preferred vaginal delivery for themselves or their partners, over half were willing to perform a cesarean on maternal request.
mod_finding: Male physicians, those <40 years old, those with <10 years experience, and those with a personal history of cesarean were more likely to prefer cesarean delivery.
